summary: Complete testing of NEXRYDE Chat Module Refactoring and Crypto Coming Soon UI. All 13 backend tests PASSED (100%). All 7 frontend tests PASSED (100%). WebSocket real-time chat, AI chat, presets, history, and unread count all working. Crypto Payments 'Coming Soon' section with BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL coins fully implemented.

WebSocket implementation in routers/chat.py (lines 94-141) with ConnectionManager class properly handles connections, disconnections, and broadcasts
Frontend chat.tsx derives WebSocket URL correctly from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https→wss, http→ws)
AI Chat integration with GPT-4o-mini working via emergentintegrations library
Crypto Coming Soon section properly implemented with all 4 coins (BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL) and 'Notify me when available' button
test_credentials: No credentials required - endpoints tested with dynamic user IDs
